title: Factorial ablation of the dual-path VLM defect detector — frame selection (A) x prompt (B)

supersedes._note: EXP002 is a NEW experiment id, not an edit of EXP001. experiments/exp001/ stays immutable; its n=16 pilot numbers were already reported. EXP002 exists because the condition set changed from 2 endpoints to a 4-cell factorial ablation, which the freeze policy requires to be a new id.
supersedes.relation_to_exp001: EXP001's two arms map onto EXP002's A0B0 (uniform + naive) and A1B1 (pixel-only selection + dual-path). EXP002 adds A3 (pixel+DOM fused selection) and the A3B0 / A3B1 cells.

freeze_policy.rule: Once status is 'frozen', no field below may change while EXP002 results are being collected. Any change requires a new experiment_id and a fresh run of ALL clips under ALL conditions — partial re-runs break the paired (Cochran's Q / McNemar) design.
freeze_policy.rationale: The ablation is only interpretable if every cell saw the same judge, the same decoding, and the same prompts; the only thing that may differ between cells is the factor level being manipulated.
unfrozen_by_design: poc/score_trial.py — scoring is a pure function of the cached raw responses in poc/results/exp002/raw/ and may be corrected or extended after the run without invalidating it.

factor_A_frame_selection.definition: WHICH frames are sent to the model. The DOM trace must influence frame selection for A3 — it is a selection-time signal here, distinct from the DOM evidence text that factor B may place in the prompt.

levels.A1: pixel-diff-only keyframe selection (strongest sustained pixel transition + before/after/final)
levels.A3: pixel + DOM fused selection (pixel transition score down-weighted by nearby DOM activity)

dropped.A2: DOM-mutation-only selection — excluded from the headline set; would need a selector not yet built.

factor_B_prompt.definition: the prompt only. The dual-path DOM evidence text lives strictly under B1; it does not define A.

levels.B1: dual-path decision prompt (expected-appearance reference + structural signals + DOM activity summary)

design.conditions_rationale: The 4 cells isolate each factor: A0B0->A3B0 measures the frame-selection contribution under a fixed naive prompt; A3B0->A3B1 measures the prompt contribution under fixed fused selection; A1B1 anchors the pilot's method.

condition_semantics.A3B1: fused keyframes (3) + dual-path prompt (full proposed method)

_repeats_rationale: Temperature is 0.0, so repeats do not probe sampling spread; they capture residual API non-determinism and give real variance for latency / token / cost. SD is reported even when 0.00. Total calls = 120 clips x 4 conditions x 3 repeats = 1440.

model.pin_mechanism: GEMINI_MODEL environment variable, verified by vlm_client.connect() against the account's live model list
model.fallback_on_quota: none — a 429 retries the SAME model with backoff; if the model is unavailable the run ABORTS

generation_config._status: IMPLEMENTED — vlm_client.call_json() now accepts generation_config and run_trial passes this dict on every call (comment keys stripped before the SDK sees them). Unlike EXP001, this is already wired at the frozen commit.
generation_config._determinism_caveat: temperature=0 makes the decoder greedy but Gemini does not guarantee bit-identical output across sessions; residual variation is measurement noise, absorbed by the 3 repeats + majority vote.

prompts._integrity: SHA-256 of the exact template string as it appears in poc/run_trial.py (before .format()). Verify before the run; a mismatch means the prompt drifted.

B0_naive._change_from_exp001: EXP001 baseline (baseline/v1) said 'sampled uniformly'. Dropped for EXP002 because under A3B0 the frames are fused-selected, so that wording would be a false claim and an ablation confound. B0 is now selection-agnostic.

expected_appearance_block.leakage_rule: Generic and byte-identical for every clip. The manifest's per-clip `expectation` field must NEVER be interpolated into any prompt.

A3_fusion.rule: fused_score(i) = pixel_score(i) / (1 + fuse_lambda * dom_mutations_near(i)); argmax over candidates.
A3_fusion.rationale: A CSS-only rendering defect changes pixels but produces no DOM mutation (injected stylesheet is in <head>, unobserved), while legitimate user actions do mutate the DOM — so A3 prefers strong pixel transitions NOT accompanied by DOM activity. Degenerates to A1 when no trace exists.
A3_fusion.label_safety: Selection reads only pixels and the body DOM trace, never the ground-truth label.

dataset.name: dataset_v3
dataset._gates: Both quality gates already cleared for dataset_v3 (screenshot per-type floors + video gate 120/120). See docs/dataset-standard.md and dataset_v3/video-gate-report.json.

metrics.primary: accuracy per condition: mean +/- SD across repeats, plus a bootstrap 95% CI (10000 resamples, seed 20260728) over per-clip correctness fractions
metrics.omnibus: Cochran's Q over the per-clip correctness matrix across all 4 conditions
metrics.posthoc_accuracy: pairwise exact McNemar on discordant pairs + Holm-Bonferroni; effect size Cohen's g
metrics.posthoc_efficiency: pairwise Wilcoxon signed-rank on total_tokens / latency_s / cost_usd + Holm-Bonferroni; effect size matched-pairs rank-biserial
secondary: defect_type_match — B1 conditions only, 6-way classification on correctly detected anomalies

cost_model.formula: prompt_tokens/1e6 * input + candidates_tokens/1e6 * output, from captured usage_metadata

power_analysis.framing: minimum detectable effect at fixed n=120 (dataset_v3 fixed); the n=40 exploratory grid was underpowered (0.38), which is why all 120 clips are evaluated. psi=1.00 from the pilot is winner's-curse inflated and not used as a planning basis.

environment_lock._stats_note: Cochran's Q is hand-rolled (statsmodels not installed); its chi-square p-value and Wilcoxon use scipy 1.17.1.

reference_pilot_result._role: Not a result of EXP002 — recorded so the ablation can be read against the pilot it grew from.
reference_pilot_result._labelling: The pilot's 'ours' selected frames by pixels only, so it is A1B1, NOT A3B1.
